record.question: What is the drawback of using pesticides in vegetables?
options: It increases the risk of vector borne diseases
It increases the risk of water borne diseases
It can cause chronic toxicity and hormonal problems
It can lead to severe form of thrombocytopenia
record.explanation: Answer C: It can cause chronic toxicity and hormonal problems. Pesticide exposure can cause chronic toxicity and endocrine-related effects depending on compound and exposure level. Source/context note: Risks vary substantially by pesticide, dose, and exposure route. Reference: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/pesticide-residues-in-food. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
